parameters.name: Content
parameters.description: The Base64-encoded page content. Example: "PGh0bWw+aGVsbG8gcGFnZTwvaHRtbD4=", which indicates "hello page".

parameters.name: ContentType
parameters.description:
The Content-Type field in the HTTP header. Valid values:

*   text/html
*   application/json

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the custom error page.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa create-page --name example --description a_custom_deny_page --content-type text/html --content PGh0bWw+aGVsbG8gcGFnZTwvaHRtbD4= --site-ids 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa CreatePage --region cn-hangzhou --SiteIds '[1]' --Description a_custom_deny_page --ContentType 'text/html' --Content 'PGh0bWw+aGVsbG8gcGFnZTwvaHRtbD4=' --Name example
